_about: George Henry Lewes (1817-1878): The Physical Basis of Mind (Boston: Houghton Mifflin, 1891; clean Gutenberg text) and The History of Philosophy from Thales to Comte (London: Longmans, Green; raw IA OCR). The two History volumes are from different editions: vol. I is the 3rd edition (the OCR reads the year as 1807; it is 1867) and vol. II the 4th edition of 1871. A matched pair would replace them. Added in round am: Problems of Life and Mind, first series: The Foundations of a Creed, vol. I (London: Trubner, 1874). Added in round am: Problems of Life and Mind, first series: The Foundations of a Creed, vol. II (London: Trubner, 1876; the volume first appeared in 1875, and a matched 1874-75 pair was not found). Added in round am: Comte's Philosophy of the Sciences, Bohn's Scientific Library (London: Henry G. Bohn, 1853). US public domain. No uids minted.
